subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-updates for installed ClawHub skills/plugins, and if so should that live in core gateway startup, ClawHub tooling, or a separate plugin/update policy surface?
rationale: This changes third-party code update behavior, public config, gateway lifecycle work, and supply-chain posture, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep manual updates until policy exists
options.body: Leave explicit update commands as the supported path while maintainers define trust, pinning, rollback, and audit behavior.

options.title: Design an opt-in updater
options.body: Accept a new public config and lifecycle surface after specifying security controls and upgrade behavior for skills and plugins.

options.title: Move automation outside core
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub/plugin-owned updater or documented scheduler workflow rather than gateway-owned background installs.

recommendation.title: Keep manual updates until policy exists
recommendation.body: Leave explicit update commands as the supported path while maintainers define trust, pinning, rollback, and audit behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied by history to both the current auto-update behavior and the native ClawHub/plugin update paths affected by this choice.
